verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual-mailbox SaaS, so scoped API credentials for an agent are a fair capability to ask about, and the axis applies. The pack documents no API, API keys or scoped tokens; probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt all returned 404. Sharing access with multiple team users is a related human-account feature, not least-privilege programmatic credentials, so it earns no credit.
